title: Claude Officially Launches All-New Meeting Feature: Joins Video Calls Directly as a Visible Participant, Testing Opens First to Team and Enterprise Editions

content_html:
The boundaries of artificial intelligence applications in workplace collaboration are being further broken. Recently, AI company Claude announced the launch of a new meeting feature in beta—Claude Meetings. This feature is now officially available for Team and Enterprise plans.

Core Features and Operating Mechanism: Joining Calls Directly as a Visible Participant

As an innovative feature deeply integrated into everyday office workflows, Claude Meetings completely changes the previous limitation that AI could only generate meeting summaries after a meeting.

In terms of how it works, Claude Meetings allows Claude to join live video calls directly as a visible participant. In this way, AI can not only silently record and analyze discussion content in the background, but also participate in real-time team collaboration and interaction scenarios as a visible attendee.

Available to Higher-Tier Plans: Continually Expanding the Enterprise Collaboration Ecosystem

In terms of target users, this feature is currently in beta and is being launched specifically for enterprise users who have subscribed to Team and Enterprise plans.

Industry analysts point out that as major technology giants continue to increase their efforts to make office scenarios more intelligent, bringing AI into video meetings in real time will help further break down information silos and improve the efficiency of team communication and decision-making. With the launch of this beta, the feature is also expected to bring enterprise users a smoother and more immersive intelligent collaboration experience in the future.
